h1: Size and fit help for shoppers who are unsure
overview: Wrong sizes lead to returns, and unsure shoppers often do not buy at all. We build a size and fit helper for your products that asks a few quick questions, such as height, usual size or intended use, and suggests an option with a short reason. It uses your own size charts and measurements. We test it against a sample of real products and add a plain note about how fit can vary between brands.

faq: What if I have no size chart?
We help you create one from supplier details or a few measured products. Accurate measurements matter, so we flag anything we cannot confirm and ask you to check the final chart.
Can the helper work for non clothing items?
Yes. It can help with shoe widths, ring sizes, mattress sizes, frame fits or device compatibility. Tell us what you sell, and we shape the questions to match.
It aims to help shoppers pick better, which can reduce size returns, but we cannot promise a drop. Premium reviews your return reasons so you can see whether fit is a real issue.
We do not store measurements unless you choose to. By default answers are used in the moment to show a suggestion. If you want to store data, we add clear consent and a privacy note.
